newsitem.title: USA: Engineered Support gets $11 mln business.
newsitem.headline: Engineered Support gets $11 mln business.

text.p: Engineered Support Systems Inc said Wednesday its defense subsidiary, Engineered Air Systems Inc, received $11 million in new business awards during in the past two months.
It said these awards bring the subsidiary's funded backlog to $92 million with related government options of an additional $160 million.
Engineered Air's products include water purification systems, water and petroleum distribution systems and heaters and air conditioners, among others.
